plan.about: The agreed-upon procedures the F1 Finance Audit Machine performs for the invented HANGS General Contracting LP's lender. The runner checks the engagement letter against this list; the Confirmations system shows it. Every name and figure is invented.
plan.period: As of and for the year ended June 30, 2026
plan.kind: Agreed-upon procedures: findings only, no opinion or conclusion

procedures.what: Agree each trial balance balance to the balance sheet and income statement, caption by caption.
Agree each loan to the trial balance, recompute the principal due within twelve months and agree interest expense.
Compute Tangible Net Worth as defined and compare it with the minimum.
Compute Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth and compare it with the maximum.
Compute the Debt Service Coverage Ratio as defined and compare it with the minimum.
Compute Working Capital from the balance sheet classification, compare it with the minimum and report the retainage in it.
Agree the fixed asset register, total the year's additions and compare them with the limit.
Compare the date the bank received the annual package with the deadline.
Compare each amount and ratio on the borrower's certificate with procedures 3 through 7.

stages.what: Read the procedures the bank and the borrower agreed, and the agreement's definitions, covenant levels and reporting deadline.
Procedures 1 and 2: the trial balance to the statements, and the debt schedule to the trial balance, with what falls due within twelve months recomputed.
Procedures 3 and 4: Tangible Net Worth and Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth against Sections 7.1 and 7.2.
Procedures 5 and 6: the Debt Service Coverage Ratio and Working Capital against Sections 7.3 and 7.4, with the retainage reported.
Procedures 7 to 9: Capital Expenditures, the reporting deadline and the borrower's compliance certificate.
Each finding in a draft agreed-upon procedures report and linked workpapers. No opinion; the engagement partner signs.

covenants.name: Maximum Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth

definitions.Tangible Net Worth: total partners’ capital, less intangible assets (including goodwill and acquired contract rights), and less amounts due from partners, affiliates and employees.
definitions.Total Liabilities: all liabilities of the Borrower that would be shown on its balance sheet in accordance with GAAP.
definitions.EBITDA: for a fiscal year, net income plus interest expense, depreciation and amortization.
definitions.Current Maturities of Long-Term Debt: the principal of all Funded Debt, other than the Revolving Loan, scheduled to be paid within twelve months after the date of determination, including any payment due at maturity.
definitions.Debt Service Coverage Ratio: EBITDA for the fiscal year divided by the sum of Current Maturities of Long-Term Debt at its end and interest expense for the fiscal year.
definitions.Current Assets and Current Liabilities: the assets and liabilities of the Borrower that would be classified as current in accordance with GAAP. Working Capital means Current Assets minus Current Liabilities.
definitions.Capital Expenditures: expenditures for fixed assets in a fiscal year, however financed, including assets acquired under finance leases.

loans.name: Shop and yard note
loans.terms: $15,000.00 principal monthly plus interest; the balance at maturity

procedures.text: Agree each balance in the FY2026 trial balance to the balance sheet and income statement in the borrower’s FY2026 financial statements, caption by caption, and report any difference.

Agree each loan on the borrower’s debt schedule at June 30, 2026 to the trial balance. Recompute the principal due within twelve months from each loan’s payment terms and maturity, and agree interest expense to the trial balance.
Compute Tangible Net Worth as defined in Section 1.1 from the trial balance and compare it with the minimum in Section 7.1.
Compute the ratio of Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth as defined in Section 1.1 and compare it with the maximum in Section 7.2.
Compute the Debt Service Coverage Ratio as defined in Section 1.1 and compare it with the minimum in Section 7.3.

Compute Working Capital as defined in Section 1.1 from the balance sheet’s classification and compare it with the minimum in Section 7.4. Report the retainage receivable included in Current Assets and the part the borrower’s aging expects to collect after June 30, 2027.
Agree the fixed asset register to the trial balance, total its FY2026 additions and compare the total with the limit on Capital Expenditures in Section 7.5.
Compare the date the bank’s records show it received the FY2026 financial statements and compliance certificate with the deadline in Section 6.1(a).
Compare each amount and ratio on the borrower’s FY2026 compliance certificate with the results of procedures 3 through 7, and report any difference.
